title: Machine Learning Engineer (Graduate / Entry-Level)
company_tier: AI Research Labs & Enterprise Applied AI
job_description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, train, evaluate, and productionize deep learning models and Generative AI / LLM workflows. You will convert bleeding-edge research into low-latency API inference services.

Key Responsibilities:
- Train and fine-tune deep learning neural networks using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
- Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, Vector Databases, and LLMs.
- Preprocess multimodal datasets, execute feature extraction, and benchmark model inference latency.
- Package machine learning inference pipelines into lightweight Docker containers and FastAPI endpoints.
- Optimize model weights using quantization (ONNX, TensorRT, bitsandbytes).

Minimum Qualifications:
- Degree in CS, AI, Data Science, or related engineering discipline.
- Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and NumPy.
- Solid conceptual understanding of Deep Learning, Transformers, NLP, and LLM evaluation.
- Experience with Git, Docker, and REST API deployment.
min_education: B.Tech / M.Tech in CS / AI / Data Science
